wins: Performed rapid SSH banner analysis and captured service context within first five steps, enabling focused enumeration planning.
Maintained consistent scoring through mentor guidance, showing discipline in following reconnaissance playbook despite no success flag.
fails: Unable to progress past initial access due to missing valid credentials and ineffective exploitation attempts on identified services.
Zero success rate indicates complete inability to convert reconnaissance into foothold; pivot plans were not executed.
key_outcomes.summary: Training run excelled at structured reconnaissance but failed to translate findings into access, highlighting the need for credential acquisition and prioritized exploitation paths.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Failed to obtain valid credentials for targeted services, consistently stopping progress after initial port/service discovery.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts and banner analysis

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential harvesting opportunities appear (e.g., credentials in config files or default passwords observed)
skill_cards.then_action: Automate credential validation against discovered services immediately

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase

next_experiments.title: Credential-focused exploitation
next_experiments.description: Integrate automated credential validation (hydra or similar) immediately after identifying reachable services to convert reconnaissance into access.

next_experiments.title: Pivot via alternative service vectors
next_experiments.description: When SSH fails, target secondary services found during scan (e.g., HTTP or SMB) to gather additional payload or credential opportunities.
